Generate ONLY the wearable hat layer on genuine transparency. Image 1 is the approved shop icon and determines the exact hat design/material/colors. Image 2 is an existing registered headwear sheet and determines the three-view layout and pixel-art treatment. Images 3, 4, 5 are the character front, facing left, and back, for head-fit reference ONLY; do not include any character pixels in output.
Output a 1056 by 832 transparent sheet of THREE EQUAL 352 by 832 cells in this precise order: FRONT, LEFT PROFILE facing left, BACK. Each cell is a full-body registration frame but contains ONLY the hat in its upper portion; leave the entire area below y=280 fully transparent. Target the head crown at x=188,y=44 front/back, x=160,y=44 profile within each cell. Hat brim should sit at y=138 to 156, above the eyes at y=184. Hat width about 320 pixels front/back, 296 profile. Peak must remain within canvas. Straps may extend to y=270 at sides of cheeks, leave face opening empty. Keep every view in its own cell.
Style: crisp warm detailed pixel-art, stepped edges, small coherent color palette, outlines matching existing headwear, no blur, no text, no grid lines, no people, no hair, no skin, no clothes. Do not draw checkerboard; actual transparent alpha.
